name: opencrane-2
description: OpenCrane 2 monorepo: event core, server and supporting libraries.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:code && npm run lint:deps && npm run lint:unused && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:links && npm run lint:fixtures
scripts.lint:deps: depcruise apps/computer/src apps/ops/src apps/server/src apps/web/src libs --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.visual:f2-drawers: npm run ng -w apps/web -- build --browser test/overlays-main.ts --ts-config test/tsconfig.live-view.json --output-path dist/overlays --base-href /overlay-fixture/ && node scripts/check-f2-drawers.mjs
scripts.visual:f5-workspace: npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/check-f5-workspace.mjs
scripts.visual:p3-5-approvals: npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/check-p3-5-approvals.mjs
scripts.visual:integrations: npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/check-integrations-screens.mjs
scripts.visual:p3-18-screens: npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/check-p3-18-screens.mjs
scripts.visual:p4-14-chat: npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/check-p4-14-chat.mjs
scripts.visual:p4-4-screens: npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/check-p4-4-screens.mjs
scripts.visual:p4-21-screens: npm run build -w apps/web && node scripts/check-p4-21-screens.mjs
